label: PCF8523 Logger Heartbeat Demo
info: An Inject node fires every 10 seconds, triggering the periph-pcf8523 node to read the current date/time and the battery status flags. A one-shot Inject node (firing shortly after deploy) sends msg.payload.datetime built from the host's Date.now(), synchronizing the RTC to the host clock. The node is configured with Timer B enabled as a 10-minute countdown heartbeat (source clock 1/60 Hz, value 10); each time it fires, the node emits a separate {source: "timer_b"} message, which a Function node turns into a "still alive" log line — showing INT2's dedicated Timer B path alongside the polled read in one flow.
